_doc: Part 4: evidence artifacts, the real view SQL and the three ADD-only writes.

label.text:
CREATE VIEW memory_current AS
SELECT m.* FROM memory m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tombstone t
                  WHERE t.target_id = m.id
                    AND t.target_kind = 'memory')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM supersession s
                  WHERE s.parent_id = m.id);

add()        INSERT row  +  queue embed job
supersede()  INSERT new row  +  INSERT supersession
tombstone()  INSERT tombstone row

No UPDATE. No DELETE.
(only exceptions: the async embedding fill
 and the is_current cache column)
